name: data_comments_tool
description: Data tool - A comment in Webflow is user feedback attached to a specific element or page inside the Designer, stored as a top-level thread with optional replies. Each comment includes author info, timestamps, content, resolved state, and design-context metadata like page location and breakpoint. Use this tool to inspect feedback discussions, filter threads by page, resolution status, or creation date, search for comment users by email, and create replies to existing threads.

label.description: Label echoed in the response for this action item. It does not select which action runs.

comment_thread_id.description: The comment thread's unique ID to reply to.

content.description: The reply content. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character. Maximum 2040 characters.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

create_reply.description: Create a reply to an existing comment thread. The reply content must be between 1 and 2040 characters and contain at least one non-whitespace character.

anyOf.description: Run create_reply: Create a reply to an existing comment thread. The reply content must be between 1 and 2040 characters and contain at least one non-whitespace character.

site_id.description: The site's unique ID, used to get its comment thread.

comment_thread_id.description: The comment thread's unique ID, used to get its details.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

offset.description: Offset used for pagination if the results have more than limit records.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be returned (max limit: 100)

sortBy.description: Sort the results by the given field.

sortOrder.description: Sort the results by the given order.

get_comment_thread.description: Get the details of a specific comment thread.

anyOf.description: Run get_comment_thread: Get the details of a specific comment thread.

site_id.description: The site's unique ID, used to list its comment replies.

comment_thread_id.description: The comment thread's unique ID, used to list its replies.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

offset.description: Offset used for pagination if the results have more than limit records.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be returned (max limit: 100)

sortBy.description: Sort the results by the given field.

sortOrder.description: Sort the results by the given order.

list_comment_replies.description: List all replies for a specific comment thread, with optional locale filtering.

anyOf.description: Run list_comment_replies: List all replies for a specific comment thread, with optional locale filtering.

site_id.description: The site's unique ID, used to list its comment threads.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

pageId.description: Comma-separated list of page IDs to filter threads by specific pages.

isResolved.description: Filter by resolution status. Pass true for resolved threads, false for unresolved.

gte.description: Filter for threads created on or after this ISO 8601 date-time (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z).

lte.description: Filter for threads created on or before this ISO 8601 date-time (e.g. 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z).

createdOn.description: Filter threads by creation date range.

offset.description: Offset used for pagination if the results have more than limit records.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be returned (max limit: 100)

sortBy.description: Sort the results by the given field.

sortOrder.description: Sort the results by the given order.

list_comment_threads.description: List all comment threads for a specific site, with optional filtering by page, resolution status, and creation date range.

anyOf.description: Run list_comment_threads: List all comment threads for a specific site, with optional filtering by page, resolution status, and creation date range.

email.description: The email address to search for.

search_comment_user_by_email.description: Search for a workspace comment user by their email address. Returns user details for the given email if found.

anyOf.description: Run search_comment_user_by_email: Search for a workspace comment user by their email address. Returns user details for the given email if found.

actions.description: Actions to execute sequentially. Each array item must include label and exactly one action property: create_reply, get_comment_thread, list_comment_replies, list_comment_threads, search_comment_user_by_email.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."
